capabilities: Import public D&D Beyond character sheets as statblock notes
Re-sync previously imported characters with D&D Beyond
Embed the D&D Beyond character sheet page inside the statblock note
Override the statblock template per character via frontmatter
Configure output folders and detail level for imported content
disambiguation: Imports characters specifically as Atlas VTT-compatible statblocks, not generic character sheet notes.
extras: The plugin fetches from an unofficial, undocumented D&D Beyond endpoint that could change or break without warning; it is read-only and never writes to D&D Beyond. Character sheets must be set to Public. The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fetch D&D Beyond character data or turn it into VTT-ready statblock notes, so converting sheets by hand is tedious.

relations.evidence: Import any public D&D Beyond character sheet into Obsidian
ready to use statblock for Atlas VTT
Install the Force note view mode plugin. The importer makes use of this plugin

summary: Imports public D&D Beyond character sheets into Obsidian as statblock notes formatted for use with Atlas VTT.
